name: Vivecraft
subtitle: Minecraft Java 26.2 in VR, native on Vision Pro
localizedDescription: Minecraft Java Edition 26.2 with Vivecraft, running natively on Apple Vision Pro. The client is compiled into the app because visionOS has no JIT. A Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition has to sign in once on a device before it will launch; after that, other accounts and Offline play work. VR controllers use Vivecraft's Touch bindings, and hand tracking is the fallback. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
